purpose: Reduce GitHub Actions runner-allocation overhead without changing any frozen fragility synthetic world, shard boundary, seed, geometry, reference family, mandatory cell, statistic, or aggregation rule.

trigger.reason: GitHub-hosted runner starvation left more than two hundred exact matrix jobs queued after the first successful waves.

execution_equivalence.reference_job_contract: Every invocation must exactly match one object already present in execution_plan.json level.reference_jobs.
execution_equivalence.observed_job_contract: Every invocation must exactly match one object already present in execution_plan.json level.observed_jobs.
execution_equivalence.reference_lane_assignment: flatten frozen reference_jobs in execution-plan order and assign by zero-based flattened_index modulo 20
execution_equivalence.observed_lane_assignment: flatten frozen observed_jobs in execution-plan order and assign by zero-based flattened_index modulo 10
